meta.title: SuperMark Mass Lab
meta.description: Build high-calorie, high-protein shakes for lean weight gain.
lang.label: Language
landing.noEmail: No email needed, just a username and password.
landing.f1.title: See totals as you build
landing.f1.text: Calories, protein, carbs and fat update with every ingredient, measured against an 800 kcal mass shake.
landing.f2.title: Use real portions
landing.f2.text: Two bananas, one and a half glasses of milk. Set any ingredient in half-portion steps.
landing.f3.title: Hide what you won't eat
landing.f3.text: Rate ingredients once in your food profile, and the ones you avoid drop out of the builder.
landing.f4.title: Keep a private log
landing.f4.text: Every shake is saved with its exact ingredients and macros. Only you can see your history.
landing.s1.title: Create an account
landing.s1.text: Pick a username and password. It takes ten seconds.
landing.s2.title: Build your shake
landing.s2.text: Choose ingredients and portions until the totals hit your target.
landing.s3.title: Name it and log it
landing.s3.text: Your shakes stay in your history, ready to make again tomorrow.
landing.ctaTitle: Your first shake takes a minute.
demo.hint: Tap an ingredient to add a serving.
